MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and Freshwater Fisheries.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Aquaculture.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems 2.3 Fish pond 3.0 Capture Fisheries 3.1. Fundamentals of capt.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Pond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
